The enterprise digital-messaging business the universe tracked through LPSN now sits inside SOUN, so declining this leaves the exposure uncovered rather than unchanged. $2.74B (FMP) / $2.79B (yfinance), inside the $2-20B band; FY26 revenue guided $230-260M after a Q2 of $61.9M (+45% y/y).
candidates.business_summary: We build voice and conversational AI that answers on behalf of other companies. Our drive-thru and phone agents take orders for restaurant chains including Five Guys, IHOP and Jersey Mike's; our embedded voice assistant ships inside cars from Stellantis, Hyundai/Kia and several Chinese OEMs; and with the LivePerson acquisition we now also run the enterprise chat and messaging layer for large contact centres. We charge subscriptions and per-query usage fees on the enterprise side and per-unit royalties on the automotive side, which gives us revenue that recurs for the life of a vehicle. Q2 2026 revenue was $61.9M, up 45% year over year at a 58% non-GAAP gross margin, and we are still loss-making - a $42.8M GAAP net loss in the quarter against $203M of cash and no debt.

candidates.business_summary: We are building a rare-earth permanent-magnet supply chain that does not run through China. Our operating asset is a plant in Pohang, South Korea, which we are expanding toward roughly 10,000 metric tons a year of rare-earth magnet capacity, including about 6,000 tons of high-performance sintered NdFeB magnets, and we have Tier-1 OEM quality certifications across six magnet grades. Our customers are defence primes and automotive and industrial OEMs who from 1 January 2027 face a DFARS rule barring Chinese-origin magnets in US defence hardware. We are pre-scale today - $1.9M of revenue in Q1 2026 and $1.6M in Q2, with fiscal 2026 guided to $5-8M - so essentially all of the $400-460M fiscal 2027 guidance is capacity that has not yet been built or sold.
